tools.why: Powers the project-wide `cwd` scope: `:Emojis list`, `count`, `clear` and `replace` over the working directory. This is the default `search.cmd`; every other scope works without it.

Downloads the Unicode Character Database's UnicodeData.txt once per machine (cached under stdpath("cache")/emojis/) so `:Emojis unicode name`, `search` and `table` can resolve a character outside your own catalog. Without it those three report why and do nothing else. Usually already present.
